name: custom-system-builder-tests
description: Build your custom system without any line of code !
author: LinkedFluuuush

scripts.test: (cd .. && npm run build); tree expected_data/screenshots/base/ -dfi --noreport | sed 's@expected_data/screenshots/base/@@' | tail -n +2 | xargs -I{} mkdir -p "output/{}"; codeceptjs run --steps --reporter mochawesome;
scripts.test-debug: (cd .. && npm run build); tree expected_data/screenshots/base/ -dfi --noreport | sed 's@expected_data/screenshots/base/@@' | tail -n +2 | xargs -I{} mkdir -p "output/{}"; codeceptjs run --steps --grep "@only";
